none: PAS NLM-349328: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Gloria Exercitus issue, possibly of 336-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust probably left. Reverse description: Two soldiers with probably one standard between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter: 12.2mm, Weight: 1.09gms, die axis: 12
